messages.name: bypass
messages.digest: Bypass processing and output the unprocessed signal
messages.description: The wordfollowed by a non-zero number will output the dry unchanged input signal straight out the outlet without any processing; followed by a 0, will output the signal effected by.

messages.name: choosePreset
messages.digest: Select a preset
messages.description: The word, followed by a number in the range 0-2, selects a preset for theobject. These presets are to be considered "starting points" and should be tweaked for your particular purpose or desired sound. The preset options are:0: Standard - Appropriate for anything, all genres of music, movies, television viewing, etc.1; Pop - Great for any modern genre including rock, country, trance.2; Movies - Similar to standard but optimized for dynamic movie soundtracks.

messages.name: gating_threshold
messages.digest: Set the release gate threshold
messages.description: The word, followed by a number, sets the release gate threshold (in dB below full scale). When the signal is below this threshold, the release time of the compressor will be slowed by a factor of 3.

messages.name: inagc_b1_atk
messages.digest: Set the attack rate for the input compressor
messages.description: The word, followed by a number, sets the attack rate for the input compressor. The attack rate determines how quickly the compressor applies gain reduction. The value range is 0-150 on a logarithmic scale, with larger values indicating faster attack.

messages.name: inagc_b1_rel
messages.digest: Set the release rate for the input compressor
messages.description: The word, followed by a number, sets the release rate for the input compressor. The release rate determines how quickly the compressor returns to unity gain. The value range is 0-150 on a logarithmic scale, with larger values indicating faster release.

messages.name: inagc_range
messages.digest: Set the maximum gain applied by the input compressor
messages.description: The word, followed by a number, sets the maximum amount of gain in dB applied by the input compressor . The compression ratio is fixed at infinity:1.

messages.name: lim_drive
messages.digest: Set the overall gain before peak limiting is applied
messages.description: The word, followed by a number, sets the overall gain in dB before peak limiting is applied.

messages.name: mbagc_b1_atk
messages.digest: Set the attack rate for band 1
messages.description: The word, followed by a number, sets the attack rate for band 1. The attack rate determines how quickly the compressor applies gain reduction. The value range is 0-150 on a logarithmic scale, with larger values indicating faster attack.

messages.name: mbagc_b1_drv
messages.digest: Set the gain applied to band 1 before compression
messages.description: The word, followed by a number, sets the gain in dB applied to band 1 before compression. Increasing the drive for a particular band applies more compression to those frequencies.

messages.name: mbagc_b1_rel
messages.digest: Set the release rate for band 1
messages.description: The word, followed by a number, sets the release rate for band 1. The release rate determines how quickly the compressor returns to unity gain. The value range is 0-150 on a logarithmic scale, with larger values indicating faster release.

messages.digest: Set the attack rate for band 2
messages.description: The word, followed by a number, sets the attack rate for band 2. The attack rate determines how quickly the compressor applies gain reduction. The value range is 0-150 on a logarithmic scale, with larger values indicating faster attack.

messages.name: mbagc_b2_drv
messages.digest: Set the gain applied to band 2 before compression
messages.description: The word, followed by a number, sets the gain in dB applied to band 2 before compression. Increasing the drive for a particular band applies more compression to those frequencies.

messages.name: mbagc_b2_rel
messages.digest: Set the release rate for band 2
messages.description: The word, followed by a number, sets the release rate for band 2. The release rate determines how quickly the compressor returns to unity gain. The value range is 0-150 on a logarithmic scale, with larger values indicating faster release.

messages.name: mbagc_b3_atk
messages.digest: Set the attack rate for band 3
messages.description: The word, followed by a number, sets the attack rate for band 3. The attack rate determines how quickly the compressor applies gain reduction. The value range is 0-150 on a logarithmic scale, with larger values indicating faster attack.

messages.name: mbagc_b3_drv
messages.digest: Set the gain applied to band 3 before compression
messages.description: The word, followed by a number, sets the gain in dB applied to band 3 before compression. Increasing the drive for a particular band applies more compression to those frequencies.

messages.digest: Set the release rate for band 3

messages.name: mbagc_b4_atk
messages.digest: Set the attack rate for band 4
messages.description: The word, followed by a number, sets the attack rate for band 4. The attack rate determines how quickly the compressor applies gain reduction. The value range is 0-150 on a logarithmic scale, with larger values indicating faster attack.

messages.name: mbagc_b4_drv
messages.digest: Set the gain applied to band 4 before compression
messages.description: The word, followed by a number, sets the gain in dB applied to band 4 before compression. Increasing the drive for a particular band applies more compression to those frequencies.

messages.name: mbagc_b4_rel
messages.digest: Set the release rate for band 4
messages.description: The word, followed by a number, sets the release rate for band 4. The release rate determines how quickly the compressor returns to unity gain. The value range is 0-150 on a logarithmic scale, with larger values indicating faster release.

messages.name: mbagc_range
messages.digest: Set the maximum gain applied by the multiband compressor
messages.description: The word, followed by a number, sets the maximum amount of gain in dB applied by the multiband compressor. This affects all four frequency bands. The compression ratio is fixed at infinity:1.

messages.name: meterData
messages.digest: Output internal state value data
messages.description: The wordwill cause output (by instantaneous command as opposed to metering-interval described by themessage) of values which describe the current state of various internal levels of the compressor, and can be used to drive GUI objects to provide visual feedback.

messages.name: meterRate
messages.digest: Set the metering output interval
messages.description: The word, followed by a number, specifies the interval (in milliseconds) at which the meter data described above will be sent.

messages.name: meters
messages.digest: Disable/enable the metering output
messages.description: The word, followed by a 1 or 0, turns the metering output on or off. When metering is on, a list of values will be sent from the rightmost outlet at a rate specified by themessage. These values describe the current state of various internal levels of the compressor, and can be used to drive GUI objects to provide visual feedback.

messages.name: ngenabled
messages.digest: Disable/enable the noise gate
messages.description: The word, followed by a 1 or 0, turns the noise gate on or off. A noise gate is effective for reducing background hiss when no other signal is present.features two noise gates: one that operates on the entire signal, and one that only affects higher frequencies, such as hiss.

messages.name: ngthresh1
messages.digest: Set the threshold level for the band 1 noise gate
messages.description: The word, followed by a number, sets the threshold level (in dB below full scale) at which the overall noise gate will be engaged.

messages.name: ngthresh2
messages.digest: Set the threshold level for the band 2 noise gate
messages.description: The word, followed by a number, sets the threshold level (in dB below full scale) at which a noise gate will be applied to the treble frequencies only.

messages.name: noisegate
messages.digest: Set the noisegate threshold
messages.description: The wordfollowed by a number which specifies a value in dB, sets the noisegate threshold.

messages.name: outmix1
messages.digest: Set the post-compression gain for band 1
messages.description: The word, followed by a number, sets the gain in dB applied to band 1 after compression.

messages.name: outmix2
messages.digest: Set the post-compression gain for band 2
messages.description: The word, followed by a number, sets the gain in dB applied to band 2 after compression.

messages.name: outmix3
messages.digest: Set the post-compression gain for band 3
messages.description: The word, followed by a number, sets the gain in dB applied to band 3 after compression.

messages.name: outmix4
messages.digest: Set the post-compression gain for band 4
messages.description: The word, followed by a number, sets the gain in dB applied to band 4 after compression.

messages.name: saveSettings
messages.digest: Send all parameter values out the third outlet
messages.description: The wordcauses all parameter values to be sent out the third outlet.

messages.name: signal
messages.digest: Audio input
messages.description: Audio input, the signal or pair of signals to be compressed.
